scope: GitHub Release asset download counts; only direct installers are counted (AppImage, deb, dmg, Windows setup exe). ZIP files and updater metadata are excluded.
limitations: GitHub asset downloads measure download events, not distinct users, successful installs, or active users.
The five identified release-pipeline asset reads make the adjusted v0.1.11 figure an upper bound rather than a user count.
v0.1.12 is a draft release and its one download per installer is consistent with release automation; it is excluded from performance comparison.
